page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, with a centred heading and a short verse poem below it. Running head at top, page number at top right. A signature "H. ij" stands at the foot of the poem. No margin notes.

main_text.l: Cumque horrenda lues tota grassetur in vrbe-
Scilicet hæc verbi vis est, ea gloria Christi,
Hostes ignota ludat vt arte suos.
Dedecus in landem, pœnas in præmia vertit,
Offibus e sparsis populos, cætúsque piorum-
Parce crucem nobis, probrum, pœnásque minari-
Pœna salus, probrum gloria, crux honor est.
Sed parcat mihi Papa, dum impudenter-

page.notes: The Greek word "Clericos" line and the text "lestos" (likely "sestos" or "lestos") are doubtful; "suisque" and "pœnásque" read with some uncertainty. The verse is set in italic in the original; italic markup was not applied throughout for legibility of the edge. The signature "H. ij." is at the foot and is kept as a paragraph, not a catchword. The heading "IN CLERVM PAPISTICVM." is in spaced capitals and is set as a level 1 heading.
